evaluation.purpose: Evaluate architecture for adding another EVM-compatible chain without rewriting core.

questions.question: Can another EVM-compatible chain be added without rewriting the core?
questions.answer: YES — core architecture separates chain-specific adapters from signal engine and metadata.
questions.evidence: src/orchestrator/networks.js centralizes chain config; src/orchestrator/arc.js abstracts RPC; signal engine consumes normalized data.

questions.question: Which interfaces are chain-specific?
questions.answer: RPC client (arc.js), network config (networks.js), chain ID validation, gas/token symbol, block/transaction structure.
questions.evidence: src/orchestrator/arc.js uses generic JSON-RPC; networks.js defines chainId, RPC, symbol.

questions.question: Which components are reusable?
questions.answer: Signal engine (engine.js), metadata schema (metadata/schema.js), dashboard (build_012.js), artifact pipeline (build_010.js with network config), tests, logging, retry, rate limiting, validation.
questions.evidence: All these modules import network config via networks.js; they don't hardcode chain-specific values.

questions.question: Which components require adapters/configuration?
questions.answer: RPC client needs endpoint; network config needs chainId, RPC, symbol; chain-ID verification needs expected value; gas estimation may need adjustment.
questions.evidence: arc.js uses DEFAULT_RPC from networks.js; build_010.js validates chainId against config.

questions.question: What assumptions currently depend on Arc?
questions.answer: USDC as gas token (Arc specific), testnet chain ID 5042002, RPC endpoints, metadata schema referencing Arc Testnet in provenance.
questions.evidence: networks.js hardcodes Arc testnet/mainnet; metadata schema uses CHAIN_CONFIG.arc.

questions.question: What would be required for the first additional chain?
questions.answer: Add new entry to networks.js (chainId, RPC, symbol, isMainnet). Verify RPC compatibility. Extend chain-ID verification. Update metadata schema to support multiple chains. Test dry-run. No core rewrite needed.
questions.evidence: Architecture already supports multi-chain via networks.js; additional chain is a configuration change, not a rewrite.

evaluation.recommendation: Architecture is ready for additional EVM chains. First additional chain would be configuration-only with minimal adapter changes.
blockers: No official RPC for Arc Mainnet yet
Metadata schema currently hardcodes Arc Testnet name; should be parameterized for multi-chain
nextSteps: Parameterize metadata schema to use chain name from networks.js instead of hardcoded 'Arc Testnet'.
Test with a second testnet (e.g., Sepolia) to validate multi-chain architecture.
Update preflight to verify all configured chains.
